name: io.github.amidabuddha/jev-decision-mcp
description: Typed Jev decisions in one tool: choice, score, yes/no probabilities via any compatible endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Absolute http(s) API root prefix; the SDK appends /v1/systemone. Required at startup with no provider default or host allowlist; custom path prefixes are supported. Must not include credentials, a query or a fragment.

environmentVariables.name: MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Default model name sent to the configured endpoint. Required at startup with no default or model allowlist; a per-call model argument overrides it and a blank per-call override is rejected.

environmentVariables.name: API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API credential for the configured endpoint, sent as a Bearer token. Optional at startup (tool discovery works without it); decision calls require it and return MISSING_API_KEY until it is set.

environmentVariables.name: JEV_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Total request deadline in milliseconds, including automatic SDK retries (1–120000)
